recovered.source: Do you want to turn off Remote Tunnel Access? This will also stop the service that was started externally.
recovered.zh: 是否要关闭远程隧道访问? 这也将停止在外部启动的服务。

recovered.zh: 远程隧道访问注册名。如果未设置，则使用主机名。

recovered.source: The name must only consist of letters, numbers, underscore and dash. It must not start with a dash.
recovered.zh: 名称只能由字母、数字、下划线和短划线组成。不得以短划线开头。

recovered.source: Prevent this computer from sleeping when remote tunnel access is turned on.
recovered.zh: 启用远程隧道访问时，防止计算机进入休眠。

recovered.zh: 启动的任务不再存在。如果任务已生成出后台进程，则退出 VS Code 可能会导致出现孤立的进程。若要避免此情况，请使用等待标记启动最后一个后台进程。

Controls the timeout in seconds before giving up resolving the shell environment when the application is not already launched from a terminal. See our [documentation](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2149667) for more information.
recovered.zh: 控制在应用程序尚未从终端启动时放弃解析 shell 环境之前的超时(以秒为单位)。有关详细信息，请参阅我们的 [文档](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2149667)。

recovered.source: Controls whether a confirmation dialog shows asking to save or discard an opened untitled workspace in the window when switching to another workspace. Disabling the confirmation dialog will always discard the untitled workspace.
recovered.zh: 控制切换到另一个工作区时是否显示确认对话框，以询问是保存还是放弃窗口中打开的无标题工作区。禁用确认对话框将始终放弃无标题工作区。

recovered.source: Focus the last active running instance.
recovered.zh: 聚焦到上一活动的运行实例。

recovered.source:
Controls whether a new empty window should open when starting a second instance without arguments or if the last running instance should get focus.
Note that there can still be cases where this setting is ignored (e.g. when using the `--new-window` or `--reuse-window` command line option).
recovered.zh:
在另一实例无参启动时，控制是打开新的空窗口或是聚焦到最后运行的实例。
注意，此设置可能会被忽略 (例如，在使用 `--new-window` 或 `--reuse-window` 命令行选项时)。

recovered.source: Always reopen all windows. If a folder or workspace is opened (e.g. from the command line) it opens as a new window unless it was opened before. If files are opened they will open in one of the restored windows together with editors that were previously opened.
recovered.zh: 始终重新打开所有窗口。如果打开文件夹或工作区(例如从命令行打开)，它将作为新窗口打开，除非它之前已打开。如果文件已打开，则它们将与以前打开的编辑器一起在还原的一个窗口中打开。

recovered.source: Reopen all windows unless a folder, workspace or file is opened (e.g. from the command line). If a file is opened, it will replace any of the editors that were previously opened in a window.
recovered.zh: 重新打开所有窗口，除非文件夹、工作区或文件已打开(例如从命令行打开)。如果打开某个文件，它将替换以前在窗口中打开的任何编辑器。

recovered.source: Reopen all windows that had folders or workspaces opened unless a folder, workspace or file is opened (e.g. from the command line). If a file is opened, it will replace any of the editors that were previously opened in a window.
recovered.zh: 重新打开已打开文件夹或工作区的所有窗口，除非文件夹、工作区或文件已打开(例如从命令行打开)。如果打开某个文件，它将替换以前在窗口中打开的任何编辑器。

recovered.source: Reopen the last active window unless a folder, workspace or file is opened (e.g. from the command line). If a file is opened, it will replace any of the editors that were previously opened in a window.
recovered.zh: 重新打开最后一个活动窗口，除非文件夹、工作区或文件已打开(例如从命令行打开)。如果打开某个文件，它将替换以前在窗口中打开的任何编辑器。

recovered.source: Never reopen a window. Unless a folder or workspace is opened (e.g. from the command line), an empty window will appear.
recovered.zh: 从不重新打开窗口。如果文件夹或工作区未打开(例如从命令行)，将出现一个空窗口。

recovered.source: Controls how windows and editors within are being restored when opening.
recovered.zh: 控制其中的窗口和编辑器在打开时的还原方式。

recovered.source: Controls whether a window should restore to full screen mode if it was exited in full screen mode.
recovered.zh: 控制在全屏模式下退出时窗口是否应还原为全屏模式。

recovered.source: Adjust the default zoom level for all windows. Each increment above `0` (e.g. `1`) or below (e.g. `-1`) represents zooming `20%` larger or smaller. You can also enter decimals to adjust the zoom level with a finer granularity. See {0} for configuring if the 'Zoom In' and 'Zoom Out' commands apply the zoom level to all windows or only the active window.
recovered.zh: 调整所有窗口的默认缩放级别。大于“0”的每个增量（例如“1”）或小于“0”的每个增量（例如“-1”）表示放大或缩小“20%”。还可以输入小数以使用更细的粒度调整缩放级别。请参阅 {0}，了解将“放大”和“缩小”命令配置为将缩放级别应用于所有窗口还是仅应用于活动窗口。

recovered.source: Controls if the 'Zoom In' and 'Zoom Out' commands apply the zoom level to all windows or only the active window. See {0} for configuring a default zoom level for all windows.
recovered.zh: 控制“放大”和“缩小”命令是将缩放级别应用于所有窗口还是仅应用于活动窗口。请参阅 {0} 以配置所有窗口的默认缩放级别。

recovered.source: Open new windows in the center of the screen.
recovered.zh: 在屏幕中心打开新窗口。

recovered.source: Open new windows with same dimension as last active one.
recovered.zh: 以与上一个活动窗口相同的尺寸打开新窗口。

recovered.source: Open new windows with same dimension as last active one with an offset position.
recovered.zh: 打开与上次活动窗口具有相同尺寸的新窗口，并带有偏移位置。

recovered.source: Open new windows in full screen mode.
recovered.zh: 在全屏模式下打开新窗口。

recovered.source: Controls the dimensions of opening a new window when at least one window is already opened. Note that this setting does not have an impact on the first window that is opened. The first window will always restore the size and location as you left it before closing.
recovered.zh: 控制在至少已打开一个窗口时打开新窗口的维度。请注意，此设置对打开的第一个窗口没有影响。第一个窗口将始终还原为你在关闭之前退出窗口时的大小和位置。

recovered.source: Controls whether closing the last editor should also close the window. This setting only applies for windows that do not show folders.
recovered.zh: 控制关闭最后一个编辑器时是否还应关闭该窗口。此设置仅适用于不显示文件夹的窗口。

recovered.source: If enabled, this setting will close the window when the application icon in the title bar is double-clicked. The window will not be able to be dragged by the icon. This setting is effective only if {0} is set to `custom`.
recovered.zh: 如果启用，当双击标题栏中的应用程序图标时，此设置将关闭窗口。该窗口将无法使用图标拖动。仅当 {0} 设置为 `custom` 时，此设置才有效。

recovered.source: Adjust the appearance of the window title bar to be native by the OS or custom. On Linux and Windows, this setting also affects the application and context menu appearances. Changes require a full restart to apply.
recovered.zh: 将窗口标题栏的外观调整为操作系统本机或自定义。更改需要完全重启才能应用。

recovered.source: Adjust the appearance of the window controls to be native by the OS, custom drawn or hidden. Changes require a full restart to apply.
recovered.zh: 将窗口控件的外观调整为操作系统原生样式、自定义绘制或隐藏状态。更改需要完全重启才能应用。

recovered.source: Adjust the appearance of dialog windows.
recovered.zh: 将对话框的外观调整为操作系统或自定义的本机样式。

recovered.source: Enables macOS Sierra window tabs. Note that changes require a full restart to apply and that native tabs will disable a custom title bar style if configured.
recovered.zh: 启用 macOS 本机窗口选项卡。请注意，更改需要在完全重启后才能应用，并且本机选项卡将禁用自定义标题栏样式(如果已配置)。

recovered.source: Controls if native full-screen should be used on macOS. Disable this option to prevent macOS from creating a new space when going full-screen.
recovered.zh: 控制在 macOS 上是否应使用本机全屏。禁用此选项可防止 macOS 在全屏时创建新空间。

recovered.source: If enabled, clicking on an inactive window will both activate the window and trigger the element under the mouse if it is clickable. If disabled, clicking anywhere on an inactive window will activate it only and a second click is required on the element.
recovered.zh: 启用后，点击非活动窗口后将在激活窗口的同时触发光标之下的元素 (若可点击)。禁用后，点击非活动窗口仅能激活窗口，再次点击才能触发元素。

recovered.source:
Enable crash reports to be collected. This helps us improve stability. 
This option requires restart to take effect.
recovered.zh:
启用要收集的崩溃报告。这有助于我们提高稳定性。
此选项需重启才可生效。

recovered.source: If this setting is false, no telemetry will be sent regardless of the new setting's value. Deprecated due to being combined into the {0} setting.
recovered.zh: 如果此设置为 false，则无论新设置的值如何，都不会发送遥测数据。由于合并到 {0} 设置，目前已弃用。

recovered.source: Enables the macOS touchbar buttons on the keyboard if available.
recovered.zh: 启用键盘上的 macOS 触控栏按钮 (若可用)。

recovered.source: A set of identifiers for entries in the touchbar that should not show up (for example `workbench.action.navigateBack`).
recovered.zh: 触摸栏中不应显示的条目的一组标识符(例如 "workbench.action.navigateBack")。

recovered.source: If enabled, a dialog will ask for confirmation whenever a local file or workspace is about to open through a protocol handler.
recovered.zh: 启用此参数后，每次即将通过协议处理程序打开本地文件或工作区时，都会弹出一个请求确认的对话框。

recovered.source: If enabled, a dialog will ask for confirmation whenever a remote file or workspace is about to open through a protocol handler.
recovered.zh: 启用此参数后，每次即将通过协议处理程序打开远程文件或工作区时，都会弹出一个请求确认的对话框。

recovered.source: The display Language to use. Picking a different language requires the associated language pack to be installed.
recovered.zh: 要使用的显示语言。选取其他语言需要安装关联的语言包。
禁用 LCD 字体抗锯齿。

recovered.source: Bypass any specified proxy for the given semi-colon-separated list of hosts. Example value "<local>;*.microsoft.com;*foo.com;1.2.3.4:5678", will use the proxy server for all hosts except for local addresses (localhost, 127.0.0.1 etc.), microsoft.com subdomains, hosts that contain the suffix foo.com and anything at 1.2.3.4:5678
recovered.zh: 对于给定的分号分隔的主机列表，绕过任何指定代理。示例值 "<local>;*.microsoft.com;*foo.com;1.2.3.4:5678" 将对除以下主机外的所有主机使用代理服务器: 本地地址(localhost、127.0.0.1 等)、microsoft.com 子域、包含后缀 foo.com 的主机以及位于 1.2.3.4:5678 的主机

recovered.source: Disables hardware acceleration. ONLY change this option if you encounter graphic issues.
recovered.zh: 禁用硬件加速。仅在遇到图形问题时更改此选项。

recovered.source: Allows to override the color profile to use. If you experience colors appear badly, try to set this to `srgb` and restart.
recovered.zh: 允许替代要使用的颜色配置文件。如果发现颜色显示不佳，可尝试将此项设置为`srgb` 并重启。

recovered.source: Allows to disable crash reporting, should restart the app if the value is changed.
recovered.zh: 允许禁用崩溃报告；如果更改了值，则应重启应用。

recovered.source: Unique id used for correlating crash reports sent from this app instance.
recovered.zh: 用于关联从此应用实例发送的崩溃报表的唯一 ID。

recovered.source: Enable proposed APIs for a list of extension ids (such as `vscode.git`). Proposed APIs are unstable and subject to breaking without warning at any time. This should only be set for extension development and testing purposes.
recovered.zh: 为扩展 ID (如 "vscode.git")的列表启用建议的 API。建议的 API 不稳定，可能随时中断且不发出警告。仅应针对扩展开发和测试目的设置该项。

recovered.source: Log level to use. Default is 'info'. Allowed values are 'error', 'warn', 'info', 'debug', 'trace', 'off'.
recovered.zh: 要使用的日志级别。默认值为 “info”。允许的值为 “error”、“warn”、“info”、“debug”、“trace” 和 “off”。

recovered.source: Disables the Chromium sandbox. This is useful when running VS Code as elevated on Linux and running under Applocker on Windows.
recovered.zh: 禁用 Chromium 沙盒。当在 Linux 上以提升的权限运行 VS Code 并在 Windows 上的 Applocker 下运行时，这很有用。

recovered.source: Ensures that an in-memory store will be used for secret storage instead of using the OS's credential store. This is often used when running VS Code extension tests or when you're experiencing difficulties with the credential store.
recovered.zh: 确保内存中存储将用于机密存储，而不是使用 OS 的凭据存储。此选项通常在运行 VS Code 扩展测试或遇到凭据存储问题时使用。

recovered.source: Forces the renderer to be accessible. ONLY change this if you are using a screen reader on Linux. On other platforms the renderer will automatically be accessible. This flag is automatically set if you have editor.accessibilitySupport: on.
recovered.zh: 强制渲染器可访问。仅当在 Linux 上使用屏幕阅读器时才更改此设置。在其他平台上，渲染器将自动可访问。如果已启用 editor.accessibilitySupport:，则会自动设置此标志。

recovered.source: Configures the backend used to store secrets on Linux. This argument is ignored on Windows & macOS.
recovered.zh: 配置用于在 Linux 上存储机密的后端。此参数在 Windows 和 macOS 上会被忽略。
显示上一个窗口选项卡
显示下一个窗口选项卡

recovered.source: Move Window Tab to New Window
